summary: Per-wheel surface collision pass over the wheel array at this+0x134 (count at this+0x130, 316-byte stride). Computes a grip scale 1.0 - (flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC)*0.5 stored at this+0x170 and, per wheel, drives sub_4FB260 (scale) and sub_4FAF60 (wheel base) callbacks. Invokes CountedLoopCallToElementUpdate, MemoryAllocation and ShortComputation_4790, then resets the phase flag this+0x174 to -1. For each wheel element, when element+300 >= this+0x10, runs SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest (dword_5EA2C0) to find the hit surface, stores the hit pointer at element+276 and the contact offset at element+24, and propagates a per-surface value into element+296 from the hit chain (+268/+292 or +272/+288). A second query (flag 0) handles the element+300 == 1 case with a signed plane-distance bound test (+80/+84), clearing the contact (element+276 = 0, element+296 = -1) when out of bounds. Returns the loop counter.

local_names.this: wheel/surface collision callback container: wheel count +0x130, wheel base +0x134, element threshold +0x10, grip scale +0x170, phase flag +0x174
local_names.v3: per-wheel byte offset into the wheel array (advances by 316)
local_names.v12: current wheel element pointer (wheel base + offset)
local_names.v11: wheel element's +300 field compared against the this+0x10 threshold
local_names.v13: hit node returned by the first spatial query
local_names.v20: hit node returned by the second spatial query
local_names.v21: signed plane distance used by the second query's bound test
local_names.result: loop counter returned as the final value

operations.description: Read the wheel count from this+0x130 and compute the grip scale 1.0 - (flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC)*0.5, stored at this+0x170.
guard:1 - if the wheel count at this+0x130 is > 0, enter the first per-wheel loop.
Loop count times, advancing the wheel offset by 316 per iteration, calling sub_4FB260 with the stored grip scale (this+0x170) on each pass.
guard:1 - if the wheel count at this+0x130 is > 0, enter the second per-wheel loop.
Loop count times, calling sub_4FAF60 with the wheel base (this+0x134) plus the running offset advanced by 316 per iteration.
ShortComputation_4790(this), whose result seeds the returned counter.
guard:0 - if the wheel count at this+0x130 is <= 0, skip the spatial-resolution loop entirely.

Per-wheel loop over the 316-stride wheel array (base this+0x134): when the element's +300 field >= this+0x10, query the nearest neighbor with SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(dword_5EA2C0, element, 1); on a hit store the hit pointer at element+276, compute the contact height (hit+40/hit+32 dot product against element deltas) at element+24, and propagate the element+296 value from the hit chain (+268+292, or +272+288 when +268 is null).

Secondary plane test when the element's +300 field == 1 and element+276 is still null: query with SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(dword_5EA2C0, element, 0); compute the signed plane distance v21 from the hit's +40/+32 fields; depending on sign, compare |v21| against the hit's +84/+80 bounds - clearing the contact (element+276 = 0, element+296 = -1) when out of bounds, otherwise accepting the hit and copying element+296 from the hit chain.
